## Open Technical Reference Notes
- [True Solar Time Offset Reference: Singapore, Hawaii & North America](https://bazilens.github.io/bazi-true-solar-time-guide/notes/true-solar-time-singapore-north-america.html): Quantitative longitude, Daylight Saving Time, and Equation of Time offsets across 8 global cities explaining BaZi Hour Pillar and 23:00 Day Pillar shifts.
- [Ji Earth & Ding Fire Spousal Palace Directional Flow Matrix](https://bazilens.github.io/bazi-true-solar-time-guide/notes/yin-earth-yin-fire-spousal-palace.html): Structural taxonomy of all 12 Ji Earth and Ding Fire Day Pillars, mapping Hidden Stems, Output-drain vs. Resource-supported Spousal Palaces, and ecological rebalancing elements.
- [Hurting Officer (Shang Guan) & Seven Killings (Qi Sha) Mechanics](https://bazilens.github.io/bazi-true-solar-time-guide/notes/hurting-officer-seven-killings-ten-gods.html): Objective structural specification separating 16th-century patriarchal commentary from ecological Output-to-Wealth-to-Power mediation in modern BaZi analysis.
- [Day Master Strength & Useful God (Yong Shen) Diagnostic Framework](https://bazilens.github.io/bazi-true-solar-time-guide/notes/day-master-strength-useful-god-guide.html): Why surface 0% element counts misclassify Weak vs. Strong Day Masters, and how classical Fu Yi, Tiao Hou, and Tong Guan protocols determine favorable Luck Pillars.
- [2027 Fire Goat Year (Ding Wei): 10 Day Masters Timing Matrix](https://bazilens.github.io/bazi-true-solar-time-guide/notes/2027-fire-goat-ding-wei-timing-matrix.html): Ten-God transits, Wood-vault combinations (Hai-Mao-Wei), and Chou-Wei Earth clashes across all 10 Day Masters entering the 2027 Ding Wei solar cycle.
- [Beyond Zodiac Animals: Spousal Palace & Branch Interaction Reference](https://bazilens.github.io/bazi-true-solar-time-guide/notes/spousal-palace-synastry-mechanics.html): Why Chinese zodiac animal matching covers only 12.5% of a chart, and how Day Branch Harmonies, Clashes, and Hidden Stems govern relationship longevity.
- [10-Year Luck Pillars (Da Yun), Branch Clashes & Void Branches](https://bazilens.github.io/bazi-true-solar-time-guide/notes/luck-pillars-clashes-void-branches.html): Dynamic BaZi mechanics separating fixed natal hardware from 10-year Luck Pillar climate shifts, tectonic Branch Clashes, and Kong Wang Void addressing.
